edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against MettiContract.ownerOf(mettiId) to authorize the free mint.
msg.sender is compared against MettiContract.ownerOf for each mettiIds entry to authorize mints.
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner, which requires owner() == _msgSender().
block.timestamp is packed into the keccak256 randomness, creating miner-influenceable timestamp dependency.
mettiId flows into MettiFreeMint validation and mint target.
mettiId is used as the tokenId argument of the external _safeMint call, which then exercises the receiver callback.
mettiIds array drives the MettiMultiFreeMint loop and ownership checks.
Each mettiIds element is passed as tokenId to _safeMint, enabling repeated receiver callbacks.
Loop index i selects the mettiIds element forwarded to the external _safeMint call.
MettiContract is queried via ownerOf to validate the caller in MettiFreeMint.
MettiContract is queried via ownerOf for each id in MettiMultiFreeMint.
MettiFreeMint invokes the external _safeMint before any state is finalized, exposing a reentrancy path through onERC721Received.
MettiMultiFreeMint calls the external _safeMint inside an unbounded loop, exposing reentrancy through onERC721Received.
withdraw forwards the entire balance via send to a caller-controlled address.
_owner is used to query balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex inside walletOfOwner.
ownerTokenCount sizes the returned array in walletOfOwner.
tokenIds is populated and returned by walletOfOwner.
tokenId_tokenURI selects the token validated by _exists and encoded into the metadata URI.
baseURI is concatenated into the tokenURI output.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
baseExtension is appended to the metadata URI in tokenURI.
msg.sender is used both as the mint recipient and the value compared during the _safeMint receiver callback.
_msgSender() is the recipient of every _safeMint in the loop, allowing callback re-entry from the caller contract.
The withdraw recipient is msg.sender, which receives control before the send returns.
